senses.definition: vb. be or grow lean (Arabic رَذِىَ grow thin and weak);—
Pf. 3 ms. רָזָה Zp 2:11 obj. false gods, appar. make lean (𝔙 attenuavit; 𝔊 is ἑξολεθρεύσει), but sense strange, < רִזָה (v. Arabic supr.), yet even this very doubtful.
be made lean, Impf. 3 ms. מִשְׁמַן בְּשָׂרוֹ יֵרָוֶה Is 17:4.
